options.reason: The table is a TCGA expression matrix assembled for one purpose: 981 samples x ~17.8k gene-level log-expression features plus a single 5-level PAM50 subtype label. Predicting that label is 5-way multiclass classification with PAM50 as the sole target; PAM50 is listed as a leakage suspect only to forbid it as a feature, and sample_id is an identifier, not a predictor. Model selection is cross-validated on TCGA, then frozen and scored once on the external CPTAC cohort, which lacks Normal-like tumours, so macro-F1, per-class precision-recall and the confusion matrix are reported on the four shared classes while Normal remains in training. No group or time column exists.
options.title: multiclass
